title: DEBUSSY: a Python toolbox implementing an eleven-item minimum acoustic reporting guideline for autonomic-arousal stimuli
description: DEBUSSY measures the eleven-item minimum acoustic reporting guideline for autonomic-arousal stimuli in a single call: LAeq and dynamic range, attack time, tempo and modulation rate, spectral centroid and slope, harmonics-to-noise ratio, spectral flatness, roughness, sharpness, plus caller-recorded lyrics presence and delivery method. Documentation: https://hyeonjoong.github.io/debussy/
